Name: Quaint Wooden Bridge for your Farm
Author: Prismuth
Description:
[size=4]--THIS MOD USES SMAPI--
[/size][i]Follow the directions below if you want the mod to work properly.

[/i]*UPDATED AGAIN* Now compatible with 'spouse gardens'. And Birch Wood recolor is now fixed.

[size=3][u]Installation Instructions[/u]:[/size]
1. Download the main mod folder.
2. Unpack and place the 'QuaintFarmBridge' folder into the [b]Mods folder of your game install.
[/b]3. If you want one of the other wood colors, download that folder, and paste it into the 'QuaintFarmBridge' folder and overwrite the four PNGs.

[u][size=3]Compatibility:[/size]
[/u]- Due to using SMAPI rather than being an xnb mod, it should be compatible with anything. I think.
- You can place crab pots along the edges.
- Not compatible with farm types other than the basic though. Bridge won't really fit if there's no pond there.
- Pathways will not go under the parts that stick out.
[u][size=3]
Recolor Permissions:[/size]
[/u]- I have included a layered file of the tilesheet for your convenience. Which is useful because of the dirt.
- You MAY upload your own, recolored version of the .PNGs for others to use, be it here, on the nexus, or elsewhere. 
- You are allowed to use the textures I made for this mod in other mods, IF and only if, you give me credit. I would like it if you asked first though.

If anyone makes and uploads a recolor, it will be listed down below.

[u][size=3]Mod Description:[/size][/u]

When I first started playing Stardew Valley, I looked for a bridge mod to put over the lower pond on the farm, but alas, while it is lovely, all I could find was a large stone one. So later when I started gaining the ability to mods, I thought, perhaps I could do it myself. I do somewhat regret deciding to make it SMAPI, but thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/501530/?]Advize[/url], the mod was completed because they made a code template I was able to work with. They were so nice~

But yeah, I wanted to design something that would be nicer than the ramshackle bridges found in the mountain and forest, but not like, super duper nice like the one that leads to the quarry. That'd just seem unnecessary for a relatively small pond on a farm.

I considered making a second style with no gaps between the planks, or any nails, or the two big pieces underneath but... I dunno, it didn't feel right to me. If you would like that to still exist, in all the colors, let me know. 

Speaking of the wood colors... (many of which got their colors right from the game--I may not find all of them pleasing myself, but someone might. I even changed the nails sometimes to go with the woods better)
